description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which encompasses a total of 12 domains. The chart is divided into 12 colored slices, each representing a different domain and labeled with its name and corresponding percentage. The largest slice, colored blue, represents "AI/NLP Research" at 24.3%. The second largest is "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%, shown in a teal color. Other significant domains include "History" (8.2%, yellow), "Law" (5.1%, red), "Med & Health" (6.7%, green), and "Business" (5.9%, orange). The remaining domains are "Daily Life" (7.1%, light blue), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%, orange), "Geography" (2.7%, light green), "Science" (6.7%, dark green), "Math" (1.2%, dark orange), and "Game&Anime" (8.2%, red). The percentages are explicitly labeled next to each slice, and the chart visually represents the proportion of samples from each domain within the test set.
